site.name: Storefront Lab
site.description: A modern shopping-flow demo built with the public Fake Store API.

home.title: Explore products, experience the whole shopping flow
home.description: From search and filters to a demo checkout, every product and price comes from the public Fake Store API test data.
home.promiseOneText: Search and sort choices stay in the URL.
home.promiseTwoText: Your choices survive a refresh on this device.
home.promiseThreeText: No real payment, inventory, or order is created.

catalog.title: Find something for today
catalog.description: Use a keyword, category, or price sort to narrow the list.
catalog.noResultsDescription: Try another keyword or clear the active filters.
catalog.loadError: We could not load products right now. Please try again.

product.demoNotice: This product uses public demo data. Prices and inventory are not commercial information.
product.loadError: We could not load this product.

cart.title: Your cart
cart.description: Adjust quantities before submitting. This is a demo order and no payment will be made.
cart.emptyDescription: Return to the catalog and choose a product to explore.
cart.loginRequired: Sign in with the public demo account to submit a demo order.
cart.demoNotice: The demo only creates a receipt in this app. It never takes payment or writes permanently to Fake Store API.
cart.checkoutError: We could not create the demo order. Please try again.

auth.title: Sign in to view a demo account
auth.description: Sign-in demonstrates sessions and the account page. Never enter real credentials here.
auth.demoHint: Uses a test account published by Fake Store API.
auth.failure: We could not sign you in. Check the demo account and try again.

account.title: Account overview
account.description: This page only displays public demo data from Fake Store API.
account.logoutSuccess: You signed out of the demo account.
account.loginRequired: Sign in first to view this page.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.description: The address may have changed, or the page is unavailable.

generic.title: We could not complete that action
generic.description: Please try again shortly, or return to the catalog to start over.

footer.description: A Nuxt shopping-flow demo powered by the public Fake Store API.
footer.privacy: Products, prices, and orders are all test data.
